title: Do not take off or land at Adelaide Airport during the curfew
what: Aircraft operators must not take off or land at Adelaide Airport during curfew periods, unless the Act permits it.

sources.title: Adelaide Airport Curfew Act 2000
sources.quote: 6 Prohibition on taking off or landing during curfew periods (1) The operator of an aircraft commits an offence if: (a) the operator engages in conduct; and (b) the conduct results in an aircraft taking off or landing at Adelaide Airport during a curfew period

administration.who: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts
